info.title: Four Corner Property Intelligence API
info.description: Direct developer real estate discovery, transparent builder cost sheets, and RERA verification for Hyderabad without broker markups.

get.summary: Search verified residential properties in Hyderabad
get.description: Query official builder inventories by micro-market, budget, BHK, facing, and architectural features with zero broker markups.

parameters.name: micro_market
parameters.description: Neighborhood (Kokapet, Financial District, Tellapur, Narsingi, Gachibowli)

parameters.name: max_budget_cr
parameters.description: Maximum budget ceiling in Crores (e.g. 1.5 for ₹1.5 Cr)

parameters.name: facing
parameters.description: Balcony / entrance orientation (East, West, North, South)

parameters.name: morning_sunlight_only
parameters.description: Filter for direct morning sunlight units

parameters.name: min_carpet_sqft
parameters.description: Minimum actual usable indoor carpet area in sq ft

200.description: Matching verified units with pricing and carpet areas

get.summary: Get architectural room dimensions and carpet area
get.description: Retrieve verified room-by-room architectural measurements and true usable efficiency.

get.summary: Get unbundled developer cost sheet and ₹0 broker fee guarantee
get.description: Reveals base rate, floor rise, parking, clubhouse, GST, and direct builder pricing.

200.description: Complete builder cost sheet including floor rise, parking, and GST

get.description: Side-by-side comparison on carpet area efficiency, price per carpet sqft, and delivery dates.

parameters.name: unit_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of unit IDs (e.g. AKR-T3-1202,PRV-T7-1403)

get.summary: Calculate live rush-hour commute drive times to IT hubs
get.description: Real peak traffic travel times to Financial District, HITEC City, Kokapet SEZ, or RGIA Airport.

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Residential project name or ID (e.g. My Home Akrida, Rajapushpa Provincia)

parameters.name: destination_hub
parameters.description: Financial District, HITEC City, Kokapet SEZ, or RGIA Airport

200.description: Morning and evening rush-hour commute metrics

get.summary: Verify Telangana RERA legal registration and bank escrow compliance
get.description: Checks official TS-RERA approval, escrow account status, and quarterly filing compliance.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Project name or RERA ID (e.g. P02400005128)

200.description: Government filing details and escrow audit status
